rubrics.justification: Describes a good-quality blastocyst with compact ICM and cohesive TE consistent with AA grading, and appropriately notes uncertainty about exact expansion stage from a single image; minor issue is some ambiguity between stage 3 and expanded terminology.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, tubal factor, endometrium, semen parameters, BMI, smoking, alcohol, and first-cycle status with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with prognosis appropriately moderated by smoking and possible hydrosalpinx; slight overreach in emphasizing hydrosalpinx despite it not being specified.

Generally aligns with IVF practice and Gardner grading caveats, including counseling on smoking cessation, luteal support, and hydrosalpinx management; minor deviations include somewhat broad lifestyle advice and speculative freeze-all discussion.

Provides clear practical steps for current transfer and contingency planning, including smoking/alcohol cessation, luteal support, prenatal vitamins, and evaluation of hydrosalpinx/uterine cavity; useful though some recommendations are generic.
